from solution import large_product


def test_issue_example_three_largest():
    """Example: large_product([1,2,3,4,5,6],[3,6,8,9,10,6],3)==[60,54,50]."""
    assert large_product([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [3, 6, 8, 9, 10, 6], 3) == [60, 54, 50]  # 6*10=60, 6*9=54, 5*10=50


def test_issue_single_largest_product():
    """Find the specified number of largest products with N=1."""
    assert large_product([1, 2, 3], [4, 5], 1) == [15]  # 3*5=15 is max of 4,5,8,10,12,15


def test_issue_pairwise_not_indexwise():
    """Products use every pair with one element from each list."""
    assert large_product([1, 10], [1, 10], 3) == [100, 10, 10]  # 10*10=100, 10*1=10, 1*10=10, 1*1=1


def test_issue_negative_times_negative_largest():
    """Largest products must consider negative times negative as positive."""
    assert large_product([-5, -1, 2], [-4, 3], 2) == [20, 6]  # (-5)*(-4)=20, 2*3=6, (-1)*(-4)=4


def test_issue_unsorted_inputs():
    """Unsorted inputs still give the largest products in order."""
    assert large_product([5, 1, 4], [2, 9], 2) == [45, 36]  # 5*9=45, 4*9=36, 5*2=10


def test_issue_zero_requested():
    """Requesting zero products returns an empty list."""
    assert large_product([1, 2], [3, 4], 0) == []  # N=0 so no products requested


def test_issue_empty_first_list():
    """Empty input list means no products are available."""
    assert large_product([], [1, 2, 3], 3) == []  # 0 pairs available so []


def test_issue_duplicate_products_kept():
    """Duplicate values from different pairs are kept separately."""
    assert large_product([2, 2], [3, 3], 3) == [6, 6, 6]  # 2*3=6 four times, top 3 are 6,6,6


def test_issue_all_pairs_when_n_equals_total():
    """When N equals all pairs, return every product sorted."""
    assert large_product([1, 2], [3, 4], 4) == [8, 6, 4, 3]  # 2*4=8, 2*3=6, 1*4=4, 1*3=3


def test_contract_result_sorted_descending():
    """Contract: results are sorted from largest to smallest."""
    assert large_product([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], 4) == [9, 6, 6, 4]  # 3*3=9, 3*2=6, 2*3=6, 2*2=4


def test_contract_result_length_matches_n():
    """Contract: result contains exactly the specified number of products."""
    assert large_product([1, 2, 3, 4], [10, 20], 3) == [80, 60, 40]  # 4*20=80, 3*20=60, 4*10=40


def test_contract_inputs_not_mutated():
    """Contract: inputs are not mutated by the call."""
    nums1 = [3, 1, 2]
    nums2 = [5, 4]
    orig1 = [3, 1, 2]
    orig2 = [5, 4]
    large_product(nums1, nums2, 2)  # 3*5=15, 3*4=12 are top 2
    assert (nums1, nums2) == (orig1, orig2)
